reviewer: Astra; author of the bound T2 kernel state producer, independent reviewer of root registry gate
verdict: No blocking state/attribution/MIG/reference mismatch found. Only the exact healthy committed T2 ready tuple can admit, and only after exact parent-child identity, descriptor/interface and endpoint checks. Receipt is an observation, not a lease or physical-input proof.

fidelity.checks: Independently rehashed all seven frozen files and recomputed sorted name/NUL/hash/LF set ca87cb16. All five immutable SDK inputs match the build manifest, including shared child_state.h and the actual reference header.

gate_sdk.static_getters: ng_collect/ng_classify, all six directly invoked generated getters and the tiny IOKit matching/master/release functions are defined; dynamic imports independently match the build receipt. Archive contains other uncalled routines; absence of all IOConnect symbols is not claimed.
gate_sdk.method: Existing .drv and artifact bytes read directly; no SDK build or Nix evaluation.

producer_alignment.rules: All flags are 0/1, version/size/reserved are exact. A ready route requires committed and excludes fault/stop/nonzero error. Fault without nonzero cause is malformed. C observes signed error as its uint32 wire bits and does not truncate, whitelist or rewrite actual signed32 causes. All real producer initial/fault/fallback/normal-retirement/fault-then-stop states refuse admission.
producer_alignment.error_table: Supports actual kIOReturnUnsupported/NoMemory/Error, exact gated commit/timer/report IOReturn and actual parent signed error. The first nonzero cause remains diagnostic; no success inferred from a recognized code. Local getReport/setReport Unsupported and unknown/length input rejection never change childState in the producer, so they do not disqualify an otherwise healthy route.
producer_alignment.publication: Kernel stages both services before commit, copies actual acquisition into the child descriptor and creates immutable OSData state snapshots. IOHIDDevice.cpp:367-378 publishes ReportDescriptor from newReportDescriptor. Child interface is OSNumber(2,32), checked by identity at creation. Retiring/faulting removes stale state before replacement; failure may yield a missing property. Gate treats missing/short/failed RPC as error, not ready.
producer_alignment.non_atomic_limit: Separate registry RPCs and stat calls are not one transaction. MIG can retain an older immutable OSData while the producer retires it. This is explicitly a copied past observation; no future route/queue/liveness guarantee.

identity_and_ownership.full_width: All entry IDs use uint64_t through real MIG, ng_put64/ng_u64 and Python <Q. Parent and child must have distinct nonzero IDs; exact names are NUL bounded within 128 bytes. Child sole IOService-plane provider ID must equal parent ID in both captured fields, preserving all 64 bits.
identity_and_ownership.enumeration: At most three HID results are requested so a third/unknown/duplicate is terminal refusal. Exactly PDM1SPIHID plus PDM1SPITrackpad is required; separate PDSerialHID enumeration must end empty. Parent walk permits exactly one result and EOF, rejecting absent or second parents. Iterators validated before and after each completed walk.
identity_and_ownership.failure_ownership: Every nonzero returned right is retained in the finite 16-slot cleanup ledger, including error returns and repeated port names representing additional send rights. All releases attempted once in reverse order; any release failure prevents admission. Real tiny IOObjectRelease is mach_port_deallocate. Its inherited IOMasterPort obtains a host-self right internally; this review does not claim that internal right is balanced by the gate.
identity_and_ownership.status_handling: Only kIOReturnNoDevice plus null next object is EOF. Success plus null next is error. Success plus null matching iterator is clean empty; null parent iterator cannot establish attribution. RPC, invalid iterator, wrong node type, non-ENOENT stat and cleanup errors are not absence or ready.

calls.io_iterator_is_valid: 2 args: port, boolean_t* (local real boolean_t, then copied to int32)
calls.io_registry_entry_get_property_bytes: 4 args: port, io_name_t key, io_struct_inband_t[4096], mach_msg_type_number_t*

mig_abi.property_types: device_types.h:96/99 defines 128/4096 limits. IOUserClient.cpp:3708-3778 copies retained OSData bytes and OSNumber::numberOfBytes from native uint64. Thus frozen OSNumber32 value2 is exactly four little-endian bytes. Getter does not carry an independent OSObject type tag; correctness relies on bound producer plus exact size/value.
mig_abi.matching: Uses PureDarwin tiny string/XML+out API, not CF dictionary ABI. Immediate synchronous RPC consumes each internal static matching string before the next class match.
mig_abi.no_device_operations: Reachable source only performs registry getter/enumeration RPCs, send-right cleanup and lstat. No IOServiceOpen/IOConnect, report/feature/output command, registry setter, mapping, MMIO, endpoint open/grab/read or retry.

reference_binding.checks: Parsed generated initializer and compared all110 bytes with private actual attempt002 descriptor. Same header SHA in kernel and gate immutable inputs. Executable contains one exact110-byte reference. C memcmp checks full returned descriptor; decoder uses fixed actual SHA. Optional synthetic digest parameter is never passed by production decode.

decoder.method: Explicit LE byte operations, no unaligned struct casts. Exactly one fresh nonce begin; adjacent JSON+11 indexed64-byte hex chunks+footer. SHA256, exact counts, reserved tail, raw result, footer result and strict JSON key/types must all agree with independently recomputed verdict. Only CR removal; no warning/escape filtering. Duplicate/stray/incomplete exports fail.
decoder.exit_separation: Exporter returns1 on stdout failure even if its earlier observation field was0; integration must still require actual process/supervisor success. Decoder does not manufacture that process-status evidence.
decoder.privacy: Public summary omits IDs; complete raw record is private. Output directory created0700. A decoded READY is neither physical input nor an open-device result.

checks_performed.frozen_tests: All5 groups passed independently against unchanged files:24 RPC failure boundaries,7 release boundaries,30000 C/Python mutations,5 assertion-killed compiling mutants, NDEBUG negative, actual descriptor framing.
checks_performed.sanitizers: ASan+UBSan active. Only execution environment changed detect_leaks=1 to detect_leaks=0 in the test driver because of the documented sandbox LeakSanitizer restriction; no source/test file changed. No SDK or target build.
checks_performed.additional_case_scope: Explicit initial, healthy commit, normal retirement, and precommit/committed/fault-then-stop cases with actual named IOReturn values and signed32 extrema. Separate high32 provider mismatch/null/alias negatives passed. Cases are host software policy checks only.

nonblocking_notes.finding: Non-ready classification is broader than exact frozen-producer reachability. Example committed0/route0/fault0/stop1/error0xffffffff is classified77 although current producer does not generate it. The only result0 tuple is exact healthy committed ready, so this cannot admit an impossible state.
nonblocking_notes.action: Do not describe exit77 as proof of a reachable producer transition. Tighten only if a later consumer needs that distinction; no current admission blocker.

nonblocking_notes.finding: Node existence and copied ready state do not establish queue exclusivity, actual report delivery or a still-live child. Enumeration/state reads are non-atomic, as documented.
nonblocking_notes.action: Retain actual gate process status and raw binding; later runtime/input qualification remains separate.
